references.text:
# The Unchanging Lane: AI Video Prompts & Production Bible (12 Clips)

## Production Specifications
- **Runtime:** 30:00 (1800s)
- **Master Pulse:** 0.8Hz rhythm (1.25s cycle · exactly 8 cycles per 10s clip)
- **Standard Delivery:** 3840x2160 @ 24fps · Anamorphic 2.39:1 framed in 16:9
- **Color Pipeline:** Raw AI Gen -> DaVinci Resolve Grade via designated LUTs

**Global Style Block:**
`Cinematic sci-fi, anamorphic 2.39:1 look framed in 16:9, shallow depth of field, volumetric light, film grain, no text, no logos, no watermark.`

**Character Block:**
`ELARA, woman, 28, dark shoulder-length hair, pale skin, wearing a dark utility jacket, a small glowing neural lace behind her left ear.`

**Global Negative Prompt:**
`text, subtitles, watermark, logo, cartoon, distorted hands, extra fingers, morphing faces, flicker artifacts, jump cuts.`

---

## 1. HUM (00:00-01:30) | x9 | 25% | Sprawl_Cyan_Cool
**Prompt:** Sweeping aerial flight through a hyper-dense neon megalopolis at night, 2092. Glass towers dripping with cyan light, thousands of flickering holographic ads, cyan hover-trains carving light trails through smog, heavy rain hammering chrome surfaces. Slow forward drone move, endless rain, cyan palette dominant. Ends on a window alcove 400 floors up where ELARA (Character block) stands alone, face reflecting the city, neural lace pulsing cyan. Slow push in toward her eye.

**Loop note:** Keep rain and hover-train motion continuous so first and last frames match.

---

## 2. FRACTURE (01:30-04:00) | x4 | 100% / 50% | Sprawl_Cyan to Amber_Shift
**Prompt:** Interior of a small high-tech pod apartment. ELARA (Character block) types on a glowing console, but the cursor and text appear on screen a moment before her fingers move. She pulls her hands back and the console keeps typing. Pod lights flicker from cyan to amber. Through the window, a hover-train judders and freezes mid-air. Tense, handheld-steady medium shot, slight push in.

**Edit note:** Add the 'DISCONNECT' text in post.

---

## 3. BREAK (04:00-07:30) | x1 | 50% glass + 100% pull | Impact_Gold_Flash
**Prompt:** A cathedral-like server hall. At its center, a single analog lever behind a glass case etched with warnings. ELARA (Character block) raises a hammer, hesitates, then smashes the glass. Glass explodes in extreme slow motion, each shard catching cyan and amber light. She grips the glowing amber lever and pulls it hard. All holographic ads in the distant city snap off at once.

**Edit note:** This is a single non-looping take. Cut to black on the pull (12f).

---

## 4. SILENCE (07:30-10:00) | x5 | 75% | Weave_Amber_Emerge
**Prompt:** Low-angle shot at street level, rain falling on a city street after the lights go dark. Umbrellas drop and clatter. A small child (6) looks up at the grey, real sky and laughs. ELARA (Character block) kneels by a puddle, where a faint amber vein of light pulses under the asphalt. She touches the water and the amber light ripples outward.

**Loop note:** Loop on the puddle ripple.

---

## 5. TWO WORLDS (10:00-12:00) | x2 | 50% | Split_Cyan_Amber
**Prompt:** A perfectly vertical split screen with a hard center line, same street on both sides. LEFT: cold cyan, rapid flickering light, panicked people clutching dead implants. RIGHT: the same street overgrown with moss and plants, quiet, warm amber glow pulsing slowly like a heartbeat. ELARA (Character block) stands at the center, steps from left to right, and the cyan static falls off her like water. Locked-off wide shot.

**Edit note:** Better to generate left and right halves separately and composite. The left-side fast flicker should be added in post, since a true 60Hz strobe aliases at 24fps.

---

## 6. MYSTERIES (12:00-15:00) | x6 | 75% | Weave_Warm_Amber
**Prompt:** Dawn in wild overgrown land. A river of amber light flows beneath moss along an ancient path, ELARA (Character block) places her palm on it. Then an old stone well with faint ghostly whispers drifting out. Then a levitating basalt stone, humming, lifting her hand weightlessly. Slow floating camera, soft golden dawn light, mist.

**Edit note:** Three short beats. Generate each as a separate 10s clip and chain them.

---

## 7. FRAYING (15:00-17:00) | x3 | 120% | Desat_Cyan_Break
**Prompt:** Handheld montage in a dying city. Cracked cyan screens showing system errors. People pry glowing neural laces from behind their ears, then breathe deeply with tears of relief. A crowd walks out of the empty megalopolis, following faint amber veins into the wilderness. Desaturated cyan, documentary handheld feel.

**Edit note:** 'SYSTEM DRIFT UNPRECEDENTED' added in post.

---

## 8. EXODUS + ANCHORING (17:00-20:00) | x8 | 60% / 80% / 30% | Golden_Hour_Weave to Anchor_Gold_Pure
**Prompt:** A high mountain ridge at golden dawn. A trickle of people grows into a river flowing along glowing laylines toward a giant natural amber rock arch. ELARA (Character block) stands at the arch handing out seeds, books and tools. Then epic wide aerial shots of seven glowing anchor stones on mountain peaks across a continent, golden threads of light shooting between them until a golden web covers the planet. Crane up, epic scale.

**Edit note:** Two halves. Generate Exodus, then Anchoring, and chain them.

---

## 9. TEACHING (20:00-22:30) | x6 | 75% | Weave_Warm_Amber
**Prompt:** A warm valley orchard at golden hour, trees planted in a layline pattern. ELARA (Character block, but older, grey-streaked hair, calm eyes) sits among children. They press their palms to the ground, and a gentle amber pulse travels up their arms as they smile. In the far distance, a lone tower glows amber like a lighthouse.

**Loop note:** Loop on the amber pulse. Match to 0.8Hz.

**Character note:** Older ELARA, grey-streaked hair, calm eyes

---

## 10. PASSING (22:30-25:00) | x2 | 40% | Sunrise_Amber_Soft
**Prompt:** Orchard at sunrise. Older ELARA (grey-streaked hair) sits with KAEL, a woman of 20, holding her hands. Wind moves through the trees. Elara closes her eyes, her body shimmers and dissolves into golden particles that flow into the glowing ground. Kael weeps but stays steady. The orchard glows brighter.

**Edit note:** Particle dissolve over 48f.

**Character note:** Older ELARA (grey-streaked hair) with KAEL (woman of 20)

---

## 11. MESSENGERS (25:00-27:30) | x5 | 100% | Vessel_Trail_Gold
**Prompt:** Night over Earth's hidden valleys. Five vessels made of woven golden light, not rockets, rise silently, each leaving a golden trail. They pass a lone tower that flashes amber as a beacon, then accelerate upward and become stars. Cut inside to children aboard, awake, looking at the stars without fear.

---

## 12. FINALE (27:30-30:00) | x1 master | 30% | Finale_Gold_Web
**Prompt:** Earth from orbit wrapped in a delicate golden web, glowing and breathing slowly. Slow orbital pullback. Five golden trails extend into new threads reaching distant worlds, and each world, once touched, sprouts its own amber web. A starfield of linked lights like mycelium. Beautiful, organic, not technological.

**Edit note:** Single non-looping master. Fade to gold 72f, hold 3s, fade to black.

---

## 13. THE SANCTUARY (TROY'S BRIDGE) (11:30-12:30) | x4 | 50% | Split_Cyan_Amber to Weave_Warm_Amber
**Prompt:** Atmospheric interior of The Sanctuary, an underground night club in overgrown brutalist ruins along the lane. Soft neon cyan embers reflect off wet stone while warm bioluminescent amber vines snake across the walls and moss-covered dance floor. Former city refugees in utilitarian clothing sit, rest, and dance slowly in deep peace, some gently touching the bare skin behind their ears where neural laces once glowed. At the center, TROY (Character block: TROY, man, 32, weathered calm presence, wearing a dark utility duster over minimalist linen, glowing dual-phase neural lace behind right ear pulsing hybrid cyan-amber, watchful protector gaze) stands behind a heavy reclaimed timber bar, watching over the crowd like a guardian. In the background, rain gently washes over a cracked glass skylight. Slow steady tracking shot, 0.8Hz sub-bass ambient lighting pulse.

**Loop note:** Loop on the amber pulse of the dance floor moss and Troy's breathing cadence (0.8Hz / 1.25s).

**Edit note:** The sanctuary serves as the haven for refugees transitioning between the dying megalopolis and the living lane.

**Character note:** TROY, man, 32, the chosen bridge between worlds

---

# The Unchanging Lane: AI Video Prompts & Production Bible (12 Clips)

## Production Specifications
- **Runtime:** 30:00 (1800s)
- **Master Pulse:** 0.8Hz rhythm (1.25s cycle · exactly 8 cycles per 10s clip)
- **Standard Delivery:** 3840x2160 @ 24fps · Anamorphic 2.39:1 framed in 16:9
- **Color Pipeline:** Raw AI Gen -> DaVinci Resolve Grade via designated LUTs

**Global Style Block:**
`Cinematic sci-fi, anamorphic 2.39:1 look framed in 16:9, shallow depth of field, volumetric light, film grain, no text, no logos, no watermark.`

**Character Block:**
`ELARA, woman, 28, dark shoulder-length hair, pale skin, wearing a dark utility jacket, a small glowing neural lace behind her left ear.`

**Global Negative Prompt:**
`text, subtitles, watermark, logo, cartoon, distorted hands, extra fingers, morphing faces, flicker artifacts, jump cuts.`

---

## 1. HUM (00:00-01:30) | x9 | 25% | Sprawl_Cyan_Cool
**Prompt:** Sweeping aerial flight through a hyper-dense neon megalopolis at night, 2092. Glass towers dripping with cyan light, thousands of flickering holographic ads, cyan hover-trains carving light trails through smog, heavy rain hammering chrome surfaces. Slow forward drone move, endless rain, cyan palette dominant. Ends on a window alcove 400 floors up where ELARA (Character block) stands alone, face reflecting the city, neural lace pulsing cyan. Slow push in toward her eye.

**Loop note:** Keep rain and hover-train motion continuous so first and last frames match.

---

## 2. FRACTURE (01:30-04:00) | x4 | 100% / 50% | Sprawl_Cyan to Amber_Shift

She pulls her hands back and the console keeps typing. Pod lights flicker from cyan to amber. Through the window, a hover-train judders and freezes mid-air. Tense, handheld-steady medium shot, slight push in.

**Edit note:** Add the 'DISCONNECT' text in post.

---
